# Native component resource and FLOAT regressions

Unmodified original audit scripts, failed observations and validation-only
78-check cumulative-reservation prototype proof. The two complete pre-fix
source files were recovered by reversing only localized changes, then
verified byte for byte by the SHA256 recorded in the original audits and
the unchanged full-package checkpoint. They are evidence, not test includes.

The original IDEAL model accepted max_bytes=20000 while sheet_zs alone
retained20480 bytes; a128x160 input allocated745532 bytes before rejection.
Original FLOAT stamps stored KOH10 as10 ohms and KOH.01 as.01 ohms;
direct BigFloat1e-1000 overrides became a zero-ohm short.
Native IDEAL DIM unit evidence is archived separately in
test/fixtures/native_ideal_component_units. Native FLOAT/GLG accuracy is
still unverified because Sonnet Lite rejects those licensed features.

The invalid preexisting 1024-by-1024 callback response for two pins used
16,964,254 warmed allocation bytes before its late size error. The shared
circuit constructor now rejects before matrix conversion; the same public
callback reproduction uses 186,967 bytes. The original log and exact
pre-guard Circuit source are retained. Before metadata is reconstructed
from that unchanged log and checkpoint hash; the original audit TOML was
overwritten by its after run and is explicitly retained as after metadata.
